get_audio_info: get audio file metadata including length, sample rate, and channels using get_info
find_audio_files: find all audio files in a directory tree and return metadata sorted by length
create_audioset: create an Audioset dataset from a list of audio files with configurable length and stride
load_audio_with_audioset: load audio samples from an Audioset with optional resampling, channel conversion, and padding
run_audio_manifest_cli: run the audio module as a CLI to generate a JSON manifest of audio files in given paths
